newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Trading in Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shares is expected to be mixed on Wednesday with some buyers seeking blue-chip bargains, brokers said.

"Many a blue chip has become attractive price-wise, which might tempt retail buying," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Company. Beximco Pharmaceuticals, Singer Bangladesh and Bata Shoe may be among those rising, he added. Brokers, however, said the market might also see selling with investors seeking cash to bid for initial public offerings (IPOs). The DSE index rose 4.25 points or 0.40 percent at 1,048.33 on turnover of 48.6 million taka on Tuesday.
